messages:
Priya: Hey team — FinServCo (Jamal) has an escalation: after yesterday's model push they say replies are 'too abbreviated' and missing small clarifying steps. They pasted examples.

Jamal: repro snippets below. Prompt: "Customer forgot password, steps to recover"
Before (v8.5):
- "Try resetting via Settings > Security. If that fails, check your email for a reset link; ask user to confirm account email if not received. Also suggest 2FA troubleshooting steps and advise to contact support with request id."
After (v9.1):
- "Reset via Settings > Security. Check email for link. Contact support if needed."

Jamal: Notice the after-response dropped the account verification and 2FA hints — small wording but it breaks downstream bot flows that ask fewer follow-ups.

Priya: They logged request IDs and time window: rq_202903-17, rq_202903-98, 2029-03-17T14:12:00Z to 2029-03-17T14:40:00Z. No API errors. Mainly short helpdesk prompts affected.

Lena: Which model alias/version were they routed to? @DeployBot what went to hosted yesterday?

DeployBot: Canary roll: v9.1 at 20% starting 2029-03-17T13:45:00Z. Full rollout paused at 40% at 2029-03-17T15:00:00Z due to unrelated perf spikes.

Evan: Tagging in. Hypothesis: decoding defaults changed or an aggressive post-processing trim. Could be quantization/compilation change that reduced hedging. Need exact request payload + model_id + headers.

Priya: Pasted Jamal's curl and body: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-v9.1","input":"Customer forgot password, steps to recover","max_tokens":120}'
```
They also confirmed pinning to redwood-hosted-v8.5 returns previous behavior.

Evan: Good repro. Can you attach the full JSON outputs (before/after)? Also confirm there was no custom system prompt.

Jamal: Uploaded full replies as attachments in thread. No system prompt, using defaults.

Evan: I'll reproduce locally across quant profiles and float. Checking: (1) decoding params (temp/top_p) default drift? (2) any post-gen trimming? (3) safety/regeneration filter? As quick test try forcing {"temperature":0.9,"top_p":0.95}.

Lena: If it's parameter drift we may want a customer-facing mitigation: allow a generation param like "verbosity_hint" or a "preserve-clarity" toggle. For triage suggest pinning to v8.5 or adding verbose params.

Priya: Customer ETA request — this is affecting auto-resolve flows, high annoyance.

ops_oncall: I checked serving traces for those request ids. Both hit nodes with quant-profile q-int8-fast and kernel-lane v2. No request errors.

Evan: Interesting — q-int8-fast could interact with weight scaling and change token scoring. I'll run v9.1 under q-int8-fast vs float to compare token-level logits.

Priya: Mitigation shared with Jamal: pin to v8.5 or include a temporary {"verbosity_hint":"full"} param if possible. Jamal is pinning for now.

Evan (2h later): Reproduced locally. v9.1 + q-int8-fast yields systematically shorter outputs on these troubleshooting prompts. Likely quant rounding after a small weight rescale. Next: try re-exporting v9.1 with alternate calibration and run a canary.

Lena: If calibration fix can't be validated quickly prepare rollback plan. We should aim to minimize customer impact.

Priya: Noted. I'll keep FinServCo updated and escalate if we miss our SLA.

Evan: Quick operational note: add a small generation-sanity smoke test to pre-canary that compares a curated prompt set across candidates to detect "skimming" regressions (brevity/clarity deltas).

Priya: Agreed — creating a ticket to add that bench. :memo:
